answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 46681 Country: India Title: Nail cutting at night Question: Can nails be cut or trimmed after Maghrib Salah. If no, what is the logic behind it? Answer ID: 46681 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1202/922/B=9/1434) We did not see in any Hadith that it is forbidden. However, in case it is forbidden it may be due to darkness that it may lead to cut the finger. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
